documents_expected.why: 2027 call guidelines (募集要項): eligibility, amount, deadline, reporting

eligibility.rule: Non-profit organisations, groups or individuals in Saitama Prefecture
eligibility.quote: 埼玉県内の営利を目的としない法人・団体もしくは個人

eligibility.rule: Not after three consecutive years of funding
eligibility.quote: 原則として、連続して 3 年間助成を受けた団体等は申請できません。

eligibility.rule: Nature conservation or creation activities in Saitama
eligibility.quote: 埼玉県内の自然環境保全及び創出に資する活動

eligibility.rule: The applicant must take part in the work itself, not outsource it
eligibility.quote: 応募者は主体的に活動に関わる必要があります

documents.quote: 所定の「助成金給付申請書」に必要事項を記入し

documents.item: Quotes for purchases or outputs of ¥30,000 or more
documents.quote: 給付金で 3 万円以上の物品購入や成果物作成等を希望する場合、見積書 の添付が必要です。

effort.step: Send the application form by post or email to Mitsubishi UFJ Trust

co_finance_required.quote: 必要とする金額の 3 分の 2 以内、50 万円を上限とします

after_award.quote: 助成金振込後、受託者(三菱UFJ信託銀行)より「助成金使用報告書」 をお送りしますので、期限までに受託者(三菱UFJ信託銀行)宛てご提 出ください。

notes: Grants cover up to two-thirds of the need, at most ¥500,000 (in ¥10,000 steps). Food, insurance, honoraria and members' allowances are generally not covered. Forms are available at branches or online. The use report needs receipts addressed to the organisation. Decisions in February–March 2027; award ceremony in April.
